name: fxr_forest_ambush
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/forest_wait_ambush_active.state (the owner's capture of the Beetles and Avian Chaos ambush in Guardia Forest, loc 013, in the game started after the attract demo): after the Hetakes the party walks (a BFS route over the cartridge's own planes, tools/playthrough.py route_walk) to tile (21,22), steps right, up to row 19 and left into obj24, the ambush's touch trigger at tile (20,19) (op B2): the lead stops at (15B0,13F0), the capture's place, and control drops (f61 of this step). Cut at 148 frames: obj24 on 08A4 (its `04` call waiting) and obj25 on 08E5 as on the capture, obj0's 16-frame loop on 0592 with $1001-$1003 = 01 04 01 as on the capture. The scene's later steps run a little shorter than the capture's (obj25's approach starts from where this Marle stands): op D8's battle request at +229 here, +279 on the capture.
